_comment: Reinforcement insertion (doubling by number, files axis). Two 40-man player Infantry blocks face down: a host at (600, 520) and a reserve straight behind it at (600, 340). The player clicks the reserve, presses Shift+M to arm insertion by files, and right-clicks the host. The reserve marches to a rendezvous one rank pitch behind the host's rear edge with the host's heading held (its maneuver reads REINFORCING on the way), and once there its men file into the host: the host's own files side-step apart onto the even file ids, each reserve file steps forward into a gap on the odd ids, the host's frontage doubles from 9 files to 18 while its front rank holds its ground, and the reserve regiment is gone. On the commit tick every transferred man re-keys under the host's uid, so the per-soldier id stream shows one discontinuity there by design.
